snippet.title: Project Angels 2 Release Date Announcement!
snippet.description:
The wait is almost over, Commander!
We're excited to announce that Project Angels 2 is officially launching 
MARK YOUR CALENDARS!

📅 December 10, 2026 PST
🚀 Wishlist Project Angels 2 on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4766910/Project_Angels_2_Visual_Novel/

Your journey back to the Indicus Ocean is almost here.

Thank you for supporting Project Angels and the team behind it. We can't wait to share this next chapter with you!
